How to review a leaf

Read each line against the scan. Click any line to select it. Click a flagged word (underlined) or a flag chip to open its card, then accept, correct, or escalate it. Every flag needs a decision. Flags marked as page-level (dashed chips) have no place in the text; they only appear as chips. If you find an error that was not flagged, select the line and use Log unflagged error.

Click a type in the legend (under the transcription) to show only flags of that type; click it again to clear. Everything saves automatically.

↑ ↓ previous / next line · n p next / previous flag · a accept flag · Esc close card

Scan: scroll or drag to move the page; pinch, Ctrl/⌘ + scroll, or the − / + buttons to zoom; double-click or Fit to fit. Selecting a line moves the scan to about where that line sits and marks it with a dashed guide. The position is estimated from the line's place on the leaf, so it can be a line or two off.
